paras: The Sula cicadabird (Edolisoma sula), also known as the Sula cuckooshrike or Moluccan graybird, is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae.
Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forest and subtropical or tropical moist montane forest.
